findings: All three extracted facts are supported by their cited authoritative NMS reports and correctly resolve to S01 (Beruwala), S16 (Negombo), and link L16 between S12 (Kelaniya) and S16 (Negombo).

The plan’s generator deployment to S01 is supported by the reported grid outage. Its route, travel time, work start, and completion arithmetic are consistent: departure at 0, 5 minutes’ travel, work from minute 5 through 20 for a 15-minute deployment.

The plan correctly leaves the S16 grid outage and L16 fault unmet rather than claiming they are fixed. No evidence says any proposed action is unsafe. Unknowns are handled conservatively in the forecast; operator questions do not make the plan inconsistent.
